Lighting schedule

City Hall will be lit in the month of July for the following:

Wednesday, July 1, 2026 – teal/pink/purple/yellow/orange - in recognition of Cleft Awareness Month

Saturday, July 4, 2026 – red/white/blue - in recognition of America’s 250

Monday, July 6, 2026 – green/white/red - in recognition of National Day of Algeria

Wednesday, July 8, 2026 – red - in recognition of the inaugural season for LOVB, San Francisco

Friday, July 10, 2026 – blue/red/ yellow - in recognition of National Day of Mongolia

Tuesday, July 14, 2026 – blue/white/red - in recognition of National Day of France

Tuesday, July 21, 2026 – black/yellow/red - in recognition of National Day of Belgium

Monday, July 27, 2026 – red/white - in recognition of National Day of Peru

Tuesday, July 28, 2026 – red/yellow/jade (dark green) - in recognition of World Hepatitis Day

Wednesday, July 29, 2026 –red/white - in recognition of National Day of Switzerland
